The '''Hurdler''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] model produced by [[Rark (company)|Rark]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Rark Hurdler was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[November 17]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Force Alliance Pack on the Cartel Market.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
